title: Ella Sings Gershwin
scene: Postwar New York vocal jazz; American popular standards
notes: Intimate Gershwin standards with Ellis Larkins piano and exceptionally supple lyric phrasing.

title: Songs in a Mellow Mood
scene: Postwar New York vocal jazz; piano-accompanied standards
notes: Ellis Larkins supports close, restrained readings of Broadway standards and romantic ballads.

title: Ella Fitzgerald Sings the Cole Porter Song Book
scene: Verve Great American Songbook; Hollywood orchestral swing
notes: Buddy Bregman orchestration frames Cole Porter lyrics with big-band lift and precise vocal phrasing.

title: Ella and Louis
scene: Verve vocal-jazz duets; Great American Songbook; small-group swing
notes: Two contrasting voices trade warm standards above Oscar Peterson’s understated swing quartet.

title: Ella Fitzgerald Sings the Rodgers and Hart Song Book
scene: Verve Song Book series; American theatre standards; Hollywood studio orchestras
notes: Buddy Bregman’s strings and brass frame playful show tunes, ballads and elastic phrasing.

title: Ella Fitzgerald Sings the Duke Ellington Song Book
scene: Ellington orchestral swing and small-combo jazz; Verve Song Book
notes: Ellington’s orchestra and guest improvisers alternate with small-group settings around Ella’s rhythmic invention.

title: Ella and Louis Again
scene: Verve vocal-jazz duets; American Songbook; intimate swing
notes: Relaxed duets and occasional solo vocals, with Louie Bellson replacing Buddy Rich on drums.

title: Like Someone in Love
scene: Verve orchestrated vocal jazz and ballad standards; Hollywood
notes: Frank DeVol frames reflective ballads; Stan Getz adds warm saxophone on four originals.

title: Porgy and Bess
scene: Verve orchestral jazz interpretations of Gershwin opera; Louis Armstrong duet
notes: Ella and Armstrong recast Gershwin’s drama with brassy jazz orchestration and intimate duets.

title: Ella Fitzgerald Sings the Irving Berlin Song Book
scene: Verve Great American Songbook; Irving Berlin; Paul Weston studio orchestra
notes: Weston’s orchestra balances nimble swing, familiar film songs and softer Irving Berlin ballads.

title: Ella Swings Lightly
scene: West Coast small-orchestra swing; Marty Paich Dek-tette; Verve
notes: Marty Paich’s compact brass-and-reed ensemble lets Ella phrase and scat with agile ease.
